summary.text: One of the fifty daughters of Danaus by the Naiad nymph Polyxo — by lot the bride of Bromius son of Egyptus when the twelve sons of Aegyptus by Caliadne married the Danaids at Argos; distinct from Erato the Muse and Erato the Dryad nymph of Arcadia.

story.text: Apollodorus lists Erato tenth among the daughters of Danaus borne on Polyxo. When the twelve sons of Egyptus by Caliadne cast lots for the Polyxo maidens, Bromius drew Erato. On the wedding night she received her father's dagger and, like her sisters, slew her bridegroom — Hyginus names the man she killed as Eudaemon rather than Bromius.
